description: The SDD specs (tasks/prd-*) of the shown repository and its worktrees, with status, phase and task progress. Read and edit the markdown, delete old specs, and start or continue a spec with the SDD skills, here or in a new worktree.

settings.label: Agent
settings.hint: The agent that runs the SDD skills: a key of the agents menu (claude, codex, opencode…). Empty: claude.

settings.label: Prompt
settings.hint: The first message for the agent. {skill} is the skill name and {args} its arguments (--prd <name>, --prompt "…", --modo auto).

settings.label: New spec skill
settings.hint: Names of the triage skill, separated by commas. The panel uses the first one that the repository or your profile has installed.

settings.label: Flow skill
settings.hint: Names of the skill that starts and continues a spec, separated by commas. The first installed one wins.

settings.label: Worktree folder
settings.hint: Where Start in worktree makes the checkout: <folder>/<repository>/<branch>. Empty: ~/.herdr/worktrees, the folder of Herdr's own worktrees.

settings.label: Branch prefix
settings.hint: The start of the branch name that the panel suggests for a new worktree.

settings.label: Order
settings.hint: Urgency puts the specs that need you first. Grouped puts the parts of one split (name-01-…, name-02-…) together.

settings.label: Show done specs
settings.hint: Show the specs with the status Done in the list.
